text: Can wisdom be taught? Russell says yes, and that it should be an aim of education. We are told on Sundays to love our neighbour; on the other six days we are urged to hate. The parable of the Good Samaritan made a despised foreigner the neighbour, but nobody hates Samaritans any more, so we miss the point. To get it, Russell says, substitute Communist or anti Communist, the great hatred of the Cold War in nineteen fifty four.
